verdict.rationale: Modal ships official Python, JS, and Go SDKs for Sandboxes with detailed API references (Sandbox, SandboxSnapshot, Probe classes), CLI tooling, and documented examples of building AI agents on top of them, plus community developers independently confirming they built agent runtimes (MCP-JS, gRPC) against these SDKs. missing for 10: no evidence of official SDKs beyond Python/JS/Go (e.g. no broader language coverage confirmation) and no independent third-party audit of SDK completeness/stability.
